note: AS-IS BASELINE (plan ①, before any change). Today gogo-analyst writes ONE plan.md plus charts/ via gogo-mermaid; two independent page builders (skills/gogo-view's LLM pre-render and cli/internal/pages' goldmark BuildHTML) fill the same assets/vnm/viewer.template.html with four tokens and produce a READ-ONLY page. The only thing the page persists is dragged node positions (localStorage + an export sidecar). All plan feedback happens in chat with no per-line or per-diagram target, and decisions.md is prose the page cannot render as a form. Scoped to what this change touches.
